findings.title: Risk of sys.executable in frozen builds
findings.body: If dopemux were distributed as a frozen binary (e.g. PyInstaller), sys.executable would be the bootloader, not a Python interpreter able to run native_hooks.py. dopemux is not distributed frozen today (pyproject console scripts / venv installs).

remaining_risks: F-01 (LOW, accepted): a future frozen-binary distribution of dopemux would make sys.executable the bootloader and break globally registered hooks; non-blocking today (no frozen distribution).
